protocol: Fixed residual ridge head using predicted return, trailing 20-session adjusted-close volatility and their interaction. Each date has equal total fitting weight. For each forecast, fit only known five-session labels ending strictly before its signal. First 20 mature dates are warm-up. Fit on native eligibility; apply identical head to native and paired universes. No parameter or feature search. This reuses previously inspected development dates and is not a new holdout. Final full-history heads are not evaluated in-sample. No automatic live promotion.
